steps.text: Bring tapioca, coconut milk, and salt to a boil in a saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in sugar until dissolved.

Beat egg in a medium bowl until smooth. Whisk in about 1/2 cup hot tapioca mixture, 1 tablespoon at a time, then scrape egg mixture into tapioca mixture; stir. Simmer gently until pudding is thickened, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes.
Stir in vanilla until incorporated. Serve warm or chilled.

raw_recipe.headline: Coconut Tapioca Pudding
raw_recipe.description: This coconut tapioca pudding is simple to make with basic pantry staples for a light and refreshing dessert. Garnish with tropical chopped fruit.

review.reviewBody: This is a great recipe. I used pearl tapioca not quick cooking and just soaked it longer and cooked it longer.

I turned it into Almond Joy Tapioca. I used half brown sugar and reduced overall sugar by 1/3. Then I added 3 oz. shaved sweetened chocolate, 1/3 C. slivered sweetened coconut and 1/3 C sliced almonds at end. Finishing touch- serve topped with a whole almond. I had to hide the bowl so my husband wouldn't eat the entire recipe at one sitting.

I used canned EVAPORATED coconut milk ( Natures Charm)
I halved the recipe because I only had one can.
I added a few coconut flakes.
I did not add the egg
Don't forget the vanilla. It makes a big difference

It was AMAZING. much better than when I make tapioca with oatmilk, I am dairy free, gluten free, egg free right now and have been craving puddings. This hit the spot.

Yumm, I didn't use the egg it didn't need it...I used honey instead of sugar and added a pinch cardamom and vanilla from a bean and it was delish...what a delightful pudding, also I didn't have any "quick" sago so I used regular and soaked and cooked it a tad longer but no biggy. I used some ramekins topped it with toasted coconut and dates... everyone loves it!! ??
I had 16 oz of Coconut Cream and used whole milk for the rest. This is the 2nd time making this, first time I followed the recipe exactly and thought it was great. This time it's even better

I used coconut milk beverage because I didn't have any canned coconut milk left. I used the vanilla kind which is already sweet so I cut back the sugar to 1/3c. I also added in a little coconut extract at the end because I'm a coconut junkie. Slightly more gelatinous than regular tapioca, but the flavor was amazing!

Made it! I only had one can of coconut milk, so I used coconut milk and regular milk. Came out great!!! First time making it. 4 people ate it... everyone loved it. I sprinkled shredded coconut on top. :)

I read other reviews and decided against the egg addition, I was worried about tempering it anyways. I'm at the finish line and it looks super oily, so I added half a cup of powered sugar, which did nothing, then heavy cream in about 1/4 cup increments which did work. I also added cinnamon because, cmon, it's awesome. I am not found of the mucus texture, but the flavor is good. I'm not sure if the texture was my fault or if that's typical of this kind of recipe, but either way I liked it. Topped with pineapple and mango!! YUM
Tapioca Pudding is a Brazilian traditional dessert. We like to use condensad milk instead of sugar. and always in the top of it, grated fresh coconut or no sugar add dry coconut. Really good!
Yummy! tapioca is one of my favorite desserts and coconut makes everything better! I didn't use the egg, just cooked it a little longer and it got nice and thick. It was good warm and cold.
Really yummy! Used regular small tapioca, so it took longer to cook, but absolutely delicious. Worked perfectly, definitely a keeper!!

Perfect consistency and not too sweet! Pairs great with sliced mango or other fruit and can be served hot, warm or cold depending on preference. This is a great base recipe to customize to your liking!
My favorite tapioca recipe! I make it without the egg so it’s vegan!
I used coconut milk I had on hand and it was delicious. Personally I would cut back on the sugar as it was a little sweet for us.
So easy and delicious!
So easy and delicious!
First time making tapioca with coconut milk instead of regular milk. Turned out great

I don’t eat tapioca pudding, but my wife loves it. I fixed it for her birthday and she said it’s the best she’s ever had. I followed the recipe to the letter and I couldn’t have been more happy with the outcome. Thanks!

I used small pearl like another reviewer had made. I just wished she'd been more specific than "a little longer" instead of letting others guess. 
Either way, the pudding thickened up nicely before tempering and adding the egg. After adding the tempered egg, the texture of the pudding became smoother, and smelled a bit richer like a custard. I'm sure it could be made without though. Good recipe. Keeping it.

Absolutely the best! Would definitely make again!!! I didn't have measuring spoons for Salt, Vanilla extract, and had an ounce short of coconut milk, but it still tasted amazing! (I just eyeballed the vanilla extract and salt). Its very coconut-y tasting! ;p
